llm.summary: This skill is a reflective generosity-planning helper with disclosed limits and no evidence of hidden access, persistence, data collection, or unsafe execution.

dimensions.detail: Runtime behavior is proportionate: it parses user text and returns JSON guidance without reading files, calling APIs, using credentials, or modifying the environment.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains a manifest, markdown documentation, a simple local Python handler, and tests; no installer, dependency fetch, network call, or remote payload behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The use guidance is somewhat broad around guilt, family expectations, and values, but it remains tied to generosity and includes professional-advice boundaries.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifacts explicitly say personal data is not stored between sessions, and inspection found no persistence hooks, background workers, privilege changes, or memory-writing behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, documentation, and handler all align around personal generosity reflection and sustainable giving practices.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Installers should understand this as a personal reflection tool, not financial, legal, mental-health, or tax advice. Avoid sharing unnecessary sensitive financial or family details, and consult qualified professionals for major giving structures, hardship, legal obligations, or mental-health distress.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The activation language covers emotionally sensitive giving situations, but it is coherent with a generosity-practice skill and is bounded by self-reflection and professional-advice disclaimers.
[SQP-3] expected: Chinese examples appear to illustrate a cultural giving scenario while the manifest marks English; this is a minor documentation clarity issue, not evidence of hidden behavior or unsafe locale handling.
